description: Advisory code-coverage report: runs the full UI Vitest suite under v8 coverage and reports totals, change from the previous run, and the lowest-covered production files with uncovered branch counts. Generated code, tests, and fixtures are excluded from hotspots. Deliberately a REPORT, not a gate — no threshold fails it, and a failed instrumented suite remains uncertain. See specs/decisions/0002-code-quality-metrics.md.
